# Prompt Index

> 由 `make update-prompt-index` 從各檔 `description:` 產生，不要手改。

- `changelog` — Approval-gated CHANGELOG maintenance and release workflow
- `cli-best-practices` — CLI Output and Tool Usage Best Practices
- `cspell` — Automatically collect all cSpell errors and batch add to dictionary
- `docstring-guidelines` — Python docstring style guide for function documentation
- `generate-todo` — Generate the next urgent project todo item
- `github-action-sha` — Guide for pinning GitHub Actions by SHA
- `github-maintenance` — Triage and fix WeaMind GitHub maintenance items
- `migrations` — Instructions for working on migration files
- `rich-menu` — Guide for managing WeaMind LINE Rich Menus
